spans: The biggest lesson that can be read from 70 years
finding: Sutton states, as the essay's headline thesis, that seventy years of AI research show general methods that leverage computation to be ultimately the most effective, and by a large margin.

spans: The ultimate reason for this is
finding: Sutton attributes the effectiveness of computation-leveraging methods to Moore's law, generalized as a continued exponential fall in cost per unit of computation.
